name: robots/b4be1__rl-arch-assembly
title: rl-arch-assembly StackingTask (simulated UR10 placing)
intro: rl-arch-assembly StackingTask (simulated UR10 placing), adapted from b4be1/rl-arch-assembly. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
